Swarm Aero is hiring a Software Engineer to build and ship features for its Command & Control system, which directs swarms of heterogeneous aircraft. The role spans interface and service layers, real-time and degraded-communications systems, and end-to-end feature development and deployment.
Aerospace

Responsibilities
Build and ship features in the C2 system that directs swarms of heterogeneous aircraft
Work on systems that hold state and stay responsive when comms degrade or drop entirely
Move between the interface layer and the services behind it, following the problem rather than a job description
Prototype new ways to represent and control vehicle telemetry, sensor data, and scheduling
Take features end to end, from a rough problem statement through design, implementation, and deployment
Ship early and often, backed by strong CI/CD, QA, and DevSecOps

Required
Degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent self-taught depth
Real strength in fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, concurrency, networking, systems
Evidence you've built something hard because you wanted to. A renderer, an emulator, a game, a compiler, a multiplayer server, a robotics project, a serious open source contribution. We care more about what you've built than where you worked
Comfort writing code at more than one layer of the stack, and no strong attachment to staying at one
Willingness to work on problems where the right answer isn't known yet, and to be wrong in public on the way to finding it
Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret security clearance
applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State
Preferred
Competitive programming background (ICPC, IOI, Codeforces, USACO, Putnam)
Game development, game jams, engine work, or simulation
Performance-sensitive work: profiling, frame budgets, memory pressure, running on constrained hardware
Real-time or distributed systems experience: multiplayer netcode, streaming, pub/sub, robotics middleware
Graphics: WebGL, OpenGL, Vulkan, shaders
Working fluency in Go, C++, or Rust
Familiarity with video streaming protocols or geospatial applications
Active Secret clearance preferred but not required
Benefits
Meaningful equity in a high-growth defense technology company
Medical, dental, vision, and 401k
PTO and paid sick leave
Monthly wellness stipend
Daily catered lunch (office)
Paid parental leave
Direct impact on a critical national security mission
A world-class team of engineers and operators solving genuinely hard problems
